title: Naturality of inverse total-tensor pullback at a coefficient map
statement: For an identified-coefficient pro-etale pullback F, complexes P,H,M and any map q:H to M, the specified comparison sigma=proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso inverse satisfies sigma(P,H) followed by Tot(1_FP tensor Fq) equals F(Tot(1_P tensor q)) followed by sigma(P,M). No flatness or quasi-isomorphism hypothesis is needed. Dependencies: [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-tensor-descent-data].

proof.text: Take the natural total-tensor comparison sigma supplied by the existing descent data. Its inverse components are the specified inverses of proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso. Naturality of the inverse at (identity P,q), followed by F(identity P)=identity FP and the component identifications, is the stated square.

theorem proEtale_resolution_sigma_naturality
    (P H M : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y R) ℤ) (q : H ⟶ M) :
    ((proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R S c P H).symm).hom ≫
        ((Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X S).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).map (Prod.mkHom
          (𝟙 ((((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).obj P))
          ((((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).map q))) =
      (((proEtaleRingModulePullback f R S c).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).map
          (((Functor.uncurry.obj ((proEtaleOrdinaryTensor Y R).map₂HomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 P) q))) ≫
        ((proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso f R S c P M).symm).hom
